processing: 仅以无损 WebP 重新编码，逐像素核对全部 alpha 与所有非完全透明像素的 RGB；完全透明处的无效 RGB 由编码器清理。原图未裁切，显示边界由 alpha 测量，小尺寸缓存与炮塔转向在游戏中绘制。
common_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production-ready transparent sprite for the original 2D space tower-defense game Starfield Nodes. Art direction: a clearly authored HAND-DRAWN 2D top-down strategy game asset, orthographic overhead camera looking straight down, compact ingenious industrial spacecraft machinery. Strong economical hand-inked dark navy contour, broad flat colored panels with only two or three hand-painted shadow values, subtle edge wear, warm ivory trim, decisive negative spaces. Readability at only 48 pixels is paramount. This is a playable game sprite, not a shiny concept render: no isometric perspective, no photorealism, no plastic 3D render, no cluttered tiny greebles, no neon bloom or luminous haze, no generic repeated hexagonal pedestal. The functional silhouette and colored body must dominate. Exactly one isolated complete object centered on a square canvas, occupying about 78 percent of the canvas width/height, all tips inside a clear 10 percent margin, on a genuinely transparent background. No scenery, no floor, no ground shadow, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no frame, no infographic.
human_direction: 逐类指定功能轮廓、固定功能色和俯视角，以首张红色短管炮为统一风格参照；在真实建造栏、战场及缩小显示中复核。
